messages:
deploy-bot: Automated canary alert for rollout wave=3 — healthchecks failing on 6/8 pods, 5xx rate 14% (>10% threshold). Abort criteria met. abort_wave=3. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/canary-failure
jamal: picking this up. i see the alert. oncall taking command.
maria: thanks. are customers impacted yet? any frontdoor spikes?
support-ops: support telemetry shows ~dozen customers with 503s to inference endpoints starting ~2m ago. ticket volume rising.
jamal: ok. first step: ensure the abort flag is honoured. i'm toggling rollout.abort_wave=3 now.
kevin: i see abort flag flipped in control plane but proxy routing still sending some traffic to wave=3 (sticky sessions). investigating sticky cookie eviction.
jamal: thanks kevin. if routing cache can't be cleared quickly, we'll flip the feature flag fallback and then rollback the deployment.
kevin: trying to purge routing cache on envoy via /admin/clear_cache. executing: curl -X POST http://envoy-admin.local/clear_cache
maria: parallel — preparing rollback on k8s for canary deployment. patching Deployment canary-v3 -> image back to v2. command: kubectl -n inference set image deploy/canary inference=redwood/inference:v2-20260201
incident-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-0519-0001 — Canary wave 3 healthcheck failures. severity: high. Pager escalation to eng-oncall.
jamal: rollback initiated. kevin — monitor proxies, confirm no traffic to v3 after cache purge.
kevin: cache purge done. slowed but confirming 95% of connections now routed to v2. remaining sessions draining.
support-ops: customer reports are decreasing. last spike ended ~5m after root alert. we still have a couple of active tickets.
jamal: good. setting status to mitigating. will keep rollout blocked until postmortem. also creating emergency kill-switch on feature-flag service: ffctl set inference_async false --reason "canary health spike"
maria: kill-switch applied. verifying healthchecks across pods: now stable, 5xx ~0.4%.
kevin: all canary pods for v3 are terminating (graceful). no new v3 containers spun up.
jamal: handing off to maria for follow-up and RCA. i've notified product and support.
maria: taking handoff. will keep INC open until RCA draft. actions: collect logs (ingress envoy 5xx traces), canary pod logs, kernel OOM/CPU spikes, and routing cache timeline.
jamal: thanks. follow-up notes: - ensure abort flag test in staging actually evicts sticky sessions - add auto-route-purge step to abort runbook - update rollout traffic shift strategy to shorter initial step
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0519-0001 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
support-ops: customers stabilized; sending courtesy emails to affected customers summarizing root cause once RCA confirmed.
maria: closing loop with ops: logs show request header size spike causing 502 path in our upstream for v3. need deeper analysis — tagging infra and runtime teams.
jamal: nice catch. thanks team. ending handoff: oncall clear for now. next oncall (kevin) will watch metrics for 1h.
kevin: noted, will watch. :thumbsup:
